title: Period Close and Clear-Down of the Wanderlane Traveller Club Qualifying Count
content:
At the close of a qualifying period on a Wanderlane Traveller Club membership the whole qualifying count is cleared down to nothing in one movement, and the next period begins on the day the reviewed tier takes effect.

The clear-down never touches the spendable balance, and a member who has just been promoted starts the new period at zero rather than carrying a surplus forward.

Where a review is still undecided when the period closes, the count is held rather than cleared, and the clear-down follows the decision.

A membership in grace after a failed review keeps accruing into the new period, and the accruals stand whether or not the tier eventually drops.

A correction to an earlier qualifying accrual is posted against the period it belonged to, not the period it is discovered in.

A clear-down is never reversed; a count restored after an appeal is restored by a fresh qualifying accrual carrying the appeal's reference.

## The same basis set out as circumstance and treatment

| At the close of the period | The qualifying count | The spendable balance |
|---|---|---|
| The review is decided | Cleared down to nothing in one movement | Untouched |
| The review is still undecided | Held rather than cleared, and cleared once the decision follows | Untouched |
| The member has just been promoted | Cleared down, and the new period opens at zero | Untouched |
| The membership is in grace after a failed review | Accruals into the new period stand, whether or not the tier eventually drops | Untouched |

## Points of judgement

A surplus above the threshold the member qualified on is not carried forward: the clear-down takes the whole count, and what the member reached in the old period buys the tier and nothing more.

An accrual found to have been wrongly counted is corrected against the period it belonged to. It does not move to the period in which the error came to light, and it does not disturb any clear-down that has since been made.

An appeal that succeeds does not undo the clear-down. The count is restored by a fresh qualifying accrual carrying the appeal's reference.
